name: genoffice
description: AI-native office suite (docs, sheets, slides, pdf)

scripts.test: npm run test -w @genoffice/i18n && npm run test -w @genoffice/electron-utils && npm run test -w @genoffice/font-metrics && npm run test -w @genoffice/docx-engine && npm run test -w @genoffice/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @genoffice/file-parse && npm run test -w @genoffice/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @genoffice/pptx-render && npm run test -w @genoffice/ai-search && npm run test -w @genoffice/agent-core && npm run test -w @genoffice/ai-provider && npm run test -w @genoffice/storage-adapter && npm run test -w @genoffice/service-core && npm run test -w @genoffice/project-store && npm run test -w @genoffice/ui && npm run test -w @genoffice/docs && npm run test -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @genoffice/shell && npm run test -w @genoffice/slides && npm run test -w @genoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @genoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @genoffice/web-bridge && npm run test -w @genoffice/server && npm run test -w @genoffice/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/storage-adapter && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/service-core && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/ui && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/shell && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/web-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/server && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @genoffice/markdown" "node scripts/dev-shell.mjs"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @genoffice/docs && npm run build -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run build -w @genoffice/slides && npm run build -w @genoffice/pdf && npm run build -w @genoffice/markdown && npm run build -w @genoffice/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @genoffice/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @genoffice/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @genoffice/shell
scripts.dist:server: npm run notices && docker build -f apps/server/Dockerfile -t genoffice-server:latest .
